subject: koalas
one_liner: Connected climbing for the world's least available athlete.
brand_voice_notes: Sincere hardware-launch pitch that never once acknowledges koalas sleep 20 hours a day. Zero attendance is 'headroom'. Zero output is 'consistency'. The company is proud of its retention numbers and quiet about its engagement numbers. Deadpan; the metrics do the joking.

hero.h1: Meet them where they are. Asleep.
hero.sub: Perch is the connected climbing platform for koalas: live instructor-led ascents, real-time output tracking, and a community that honors the 20-hour recovery window.
hero.primary_cta: Start the trial he won't notice

features.title: Live Dawn Ascents
features.blurb: Certified climb instructors broadcast live from Brisbane at 5:15 AM, the statistical midpoint of the average koala's sleep block. Classes run daily regardless of attendance. Attendance is currently zero.

features.title: Output Score
features.blurb: One number that reconciles calories burned against eucalyptus consumed. No koala has recorded a positive Output Score since launch. Internally, we call this headroom.

features.title: Streak Protection
features.blurb: Sleeping within 40 meters of the Trunk counts as a completed workout. Member streaks average 141 days. Retention is 100%. Engagement is a different metric, tracked by a different team.

demo_screen_concept: The live-class screen for 'Dawn Eucalyptus Burn — 45 min': an instructor video tile (a koala on a climbing post, LIVE badge), a real-time output graph flatlining between 0 and 2 kJ, heart rate pinned at 61 bpm, cadence 0, and a live leaderboard of 8 named koalas whose output numbers barely move. A 'Send Encouragement' button increments a counter that changes nothing. A class-picker sidebar lists other sessions ('All-Day Doze Recovery', 'Zone 0 Endurance'), each marked LIVE with 0 attending. Leaderboard jitters on a timer; class switching swaps titles and metrics; encouragement is acknowledged, not acted on.

images.rationale: Hero skipped: monumental typographic hardware-launch style carries the hero without a photo. Demo is photo-shaped (live-class instructor video tile + koala leaderboard), so the budget went there: 1 instructor tile (16:9) and 2 leaderboard avatars (1:1), also reused as roster art. Testimonial headshots skipped because the named testimonials are human handlers, not koalas; a koala headshot beside a human name would break the bit.

design_direction.style: Matte athletic hardware-launch corridor, midnight-eucalyptus dark mode. The page is staged as the launch site of a heavily funded connected-fitness company that has decided the koala is a lapsed athlete and prices unconsciousness by the month. A matte charcoal ground with a faint eucalyptus cast (#0F1412) runs the whole page, sectioned only by a thin vertical spine line: a 2px rail that descends from the hero like a climbing line, punctuated by altitude ticks and station dots, physically guiding the scroll from hardware reveal to pricing the way a route guides a climb nobody is making. Panels are matte plates: flat fills one shade lighter than the ground (#161D19), 1px hairline borders (#243029), 12px radii, no shadows, no glass, no blur, no neon glow; depth comes entirely from monumental type scale and the rationed accent. The core motif is the Output number: telemetry figures (output kJ, resting heart rate, streak days, tier prices) set in Roboto Mono with tabular figures inside inset metric wells, most of them reading exactly 0, rendered at display sizes with the confidence of a company that believes the number is temporary. One eucalyptus pulse green (#45D08C) carries every primary CTA, the LIVE dot, the spine's station markers, and the single highlighted word per headline; a dim sage (#9DBFA9) handles links and secondary labels and appears nowhere else. Barlow Condensed sets the wordmark and headlines in towering uppercase condensed caps with locker-room confidence; Barlow carries plain, faintly investor-deck body copy. Motion is summit-restrained: the spine draws downward on scroll, sections fade up 6px with a 40ms stagger, the LIVE dot pulses on a 3s cycle, CTAs depress 1px on press, the hero Output counter ticks upward once on load and stops at 0, all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. No light mode, no glass, no blur panels, no neon glow, no clay, no bento lattice, no serifs, no brutalist offset shadows, no postal motifs, no emoji. Reads like a company that files hibernation-grade sleep under 'recovery culture' and considers the eucalyptus tree a competitor's product.
design_direction.archetype: Hardware-launch corridor landing: full-height hero with monumental condensed headline and a zeroed output counter, spec strip, three feature plates threaded on the vertical spine, telemetry metrics band, three pricing plates, testimonial plates, monumental closing CTA.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Spine line draws on scroll; sections fade up 6px with 40ms stagger; LIVE dot pulses 3s; CTA depresses 1px on press; hero output counter ticks once and stops at 0; all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Full-viewport matte dark hero. Towering uppercase Barlow Condensed headline with 'ASLEEP' as the single accent-colored word. Sub and CTA left-aligned on a wide grid; right side holds a hero metric well: OUTPUT 0 kJ in monumental mono with a pulsing LIVE dot and 'CLASS IN PROGRESS' microcopy. The spine rail starts under the CTA and runs down the page.
